card.name: Spots just before a gr- or g- word
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a split-off G or similar piece right before a word that begins with gr, such as grand, gastro, glands, granin or glycemia. It also fires on a few unrelated gaps.

modes.label: Lone G before a word
modes.description: A single G or og piece starts a longer medical word whose rest follows.
modes.example: Removal of Parathyroid<< G>>lands Parathyroidectomy is surgery

modes.label: Open bracket before grand
modes.description: A bracket or hyphen comes just before the word grand in grand mal.

modes.label: Inside names with gr or gl
modes.description: A piece like og sits inside a longer term such as chromogranin or hypoglycemia.
modes.example: 5.6 Hyp<<og>>lycemia in Patients with Diabetes Hyp

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with grand or gross and away from and.
card.plain: It fires on the start of a long word where a g-r or g-l word like grand or glands is about to come next.
